title: kbext.py init-team writes a group overlay repository: a marketplace pinning it-ops-kb by ext tag beside the group's plugin, its settings file and a verified sample extender
goal: kbext.py init-team DIR --group NAME --upstream URL [--ref ext-vX.Y.Z] writes, keeping any file that already holds the same content and refusing (exit 2) to overwrite a different one: DIR/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json listing it-ops-kb with a url source at URL and the ref (the pin rule of this story's gate) and the group's own plugin with source "."; DIR/.claude-plugin/plugin.json with skills/, agents/ and hooks/ directories for the group's own; DIR/settings/group.json naming group, extension_paths ["../ext"] and a sample lane extender in DIR/ext/. A second run changes nothing. kbext.py verify passes on it, and plugin.md gets a section on adopting by fork or by overlay, with design.md's Teams and organizations pointing at it.

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())/"grp-kb"
i=lambda: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbext.py","init-team",str(d),"--group","grp","--upstream","git@corp.example.com:kb/it-ops-kb.git","--ref","ext-v1.0.0"],capture_output=True,text=True)
r=i(); assert r.returncode==0, r.stderr
m=json.loads((d/".claude-plugin"/"marketplace.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
srcs={p["name"]:p["source"] for p in m["plugins"]}
assert srcs["it-ops-kb"]["url"].endswith("it-ops-kb.git") and srcs["it-ops-kb"]["ref"]=="ext-v1.0.0" and "." in srcs.values(), srcs
snap=lambda: sorted((str(p),p.read_bytes()) for p in d.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
a=snap(); r=i(); assert r.returncode==0 and snap()==a, "second run changed files"
g=d/"settings"/"group.json"; ws=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbext.py","verify","--root",str(ws)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,KB_GROUP_SETTINGS=str(g)))
assert r.returncode==0 and "lane" in r.stdout, (r.stdout,r.stderr)

gates.question: How does a group's overlay marketplace pin the shared it-ops-kb plugin?
gates.reason: Claude Code has no version ranges or release channels, so an exact tag is the only pin that holds a major back; the group moves the ref after kbext.py verify and rehearse pass
